title: Exploiting Common Volatility Dynamics in High-Dimensional Portfolio Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.23952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how commonalities in monthly realized stock volatilities can be exploited for high-dimensional covariance forecasting and portfolio selection. We compare latent factor models with ARMA models that pool dynamic parameters within pre-specified groups of stocks. We show that pooled ARMA models admit an exact dynamic factor representation with group-specific dynamics and stock-specific loadings. The implied static factor representation involves group-specific factors that need not be pervasive. Combining volatility forecasts with realized dynamic conditional correlations and nonlinear shrinkage, we evaluate out-of-sample minimum variance portfolios of S&P 500 constituents. Pooling-based approaches consistently outperform the alternatives across portfolio constraints and model specifications.

translated_title: 在高维投资组合选择中利用共同的波动率动态特征
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何利用月度已实现股票波动率中的共性特征来进行高维协方差预测和投资组合选择。我们将潜在因子模型与在预先设定的股票组内汇集动态参数的ARMA模型进行比较。我们证明，汇集式ARMA模型具有精确的动态因子表示形式，包含组特定的动态特征和股票特定的载荷。其隐含的静态因子表示所涉及的组特定因子无需具备普遍渗透性。通过将波动率预测与已实现动态条件相关性以及非线性收缩相结合，我们评估了标普500成分股的样本外最小方差投资组合。结果表明，基于参数汇集的方法在各种投资组合约束和模型设定下均持续优于其他替代方法。
tldr: 本文提出在预设股票组内汇集ARMA动态参数的波动率预测方法，证明其具有精确的动态因子表示，并在标普500成分股样本外最小方差投资组合构建中持续优于潜在因子模型等替代方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes pooling ARMA dynamic parameters within pre-specified stock groups, proves this admits an exact dynamic factor representation with group-specific factors that need not be pervasive, and shows pooling-based approaches consistently outperform latent factor alternatives in out-of-sample minimum variance portfolio selection for S&P 500 constituents.
